signals.title: I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the AI
signals.summary: A few years ago talking heads and AM radio personalities went cookoo over AI. The warnings were replete with assertations of total destruction. I blew them off as doomsdayesque viewer/listener headline/listener bastards that saw dollar signs in words. Assuredly, they completely misunderstood the technology and the intricacies of how AI functions and what it was capable of. They read enough science fiction to regurgitate what sounded like knowledge of the future. Interestingly, they were largely right in the end. The tech has evolved fantastically quick. The wildest scenarios preposed from previous predicions is becoming realistic. I do not worry about those scenarios. I do not fear the wildest predictions. Throughout history humans have developed weapons, ideas, technologies, and systems that detractors predicted would kill us all or would lead to insurmountable changes to society. Electricity is not the devil. The printing press was not a detriment to society. AI will fundamentally change many things. That is a good thing. Humanity will forever be preserved. What is Humanity? We will perpetually find out. Happy Thanksgiving to everyone. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/i

signals.title: Beyond Static Charts: Benchmarking Interactive Chart-to-Code Generation for MLLMs
signals.summary: arXiv:2611.31345v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In recent years, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved significant progress in chart-to-code generation. However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on static charts, overlooking interactive charts that enable richer and more expressive data exploration. Unlike static chart-to-code generation, which emphasizes visual consistency, interactive chart-to-code evaluation targets behavioral consistency, requiring chart states to evolve correctly under sequences of user interactions, thereby rendering traditional one-step evaluation paradigms ineffective. To address this gap, we introduce ChartInt, the first benchmark specifically designed for interactive chart-to-code generation. ChartInt consists of 2,779 carefully annotated examples covering common interaction patterns such as hover, highlight, and tooltips. Additionally, ChartInt incorporates editing tasks such as data updates, style adjustments, and cross-chart style transfer to expand real-world application scenarios. signals.title: ContextLure: Exploiting Benign Conversation History for Indirect Prompt Injection
signals.summary: arXiv:2611.31424v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As LLMs become more capable, agents can perform more complex tasks with tools and maintain longer interactions with users. These benign conversations contain evidence on task results, user concerns, and operational constraints. The risk is that attackers who can observe benign conversations (evidence) may construct stronger indirect prompt injections without increasing the attackers' control over prior turns or the later injection. However, we still lack a clear study of how effectively attackers can select and use this evidence. To address this gap, we introduce ContextLure, a red-teaming framework in which an attacker silently observes an existing benign conversation, extracts evidence, and constructs an injection. The challenges are twofold: (a) selecting useful evidence and (b) presenting it as reasons for an unauthorized action, without changing the prior benign conversation. themes.title: Thương mại, xung đột và rủi ro chuỗi cung ứng
themes.reading: Các diễn biến chính trị và thương mại có thể ảnh hưởng đến vận tải, giá đầu vào hoặc quyết định đầu tư. Chưa thể suy ra tác động tới Việt Nam nếu chưa biết tuyến hàng, mặt hàng và mức độ phơi nhiễm.
themes.falsifier: Bác bỏ nếu chưa có thay đổi chính sách/luồng hàng thực tế hoặc mặt hàng liên quan không gắn với Việt Nam.

evidence.title: Ukraine confirms it used naval drones to strike two Russian ships off Libya
evidence.summary: Ukraine’s security service says seven drones were launched from mothership in operation that sank Merkury warship Ukraine has confirmed it deployed naval drones in strikes on two Russian vessels off Libya on Sunday, including one that sank the corvette Merkury, one of Russia’s newest vessels. Ukraine’s security service, the SBU, said seven domestically made naval drones were launched from a mothership in the operation, which Volodymyr Zelenskyy described as “exemplary”. evidence.title: How Chinese companies circumvent chips sanctions in Southeast Asia
evidence.summary: High-tech AI chips are hard to get in China because of US restrictions. To get around this, Chinese companies often use offshore computing capacity, particularly in Southeast Asia. The US is also trying to stop it.

themes.title: Việt Nam: chính sách và điều kiện kinh doanh
themes.reading: Chỉ đáng nâng thành tín hiệu khi có văn bản hoặc số liệu gốc, phạm vi áp dụng và nhóm chịu tác động xác định được. Tin kinh doanh đơn lẻ chưa đủ để kết luận xu hướng kinh tế Việt Nam.
themes.falsifier: Bác bỏ nếu không có văn bản/số liệu gốc hoặc nội dung không tạo thay đổi đáng kể với doanh nghiệp.

evidence.title: Hơn 1.400 tỷ đồng cải tạo đường băng sân bay Đà Nẵng
evidence.summary: Đường băng phía Tây sân bay Đà Nẵng dài hơn 3 km sẽ được cải tạo, xây thêm các đường lăn với tổng vốn đầu tư 1.427 tỷ đồng, dự kiến hoàn thành năm 2028.

evidence.title: Hành trình nâng chuẩn sữa bột trẻ em của Vinamilk
evidence.summary: Từ khôi phục dây chuyền sản xuất Dielac đến đầu tư nhà máy nghìn tỷ đồng, Vinamilk không ngừng nâng chuẩn sữa bột, đáp ứng 400 tiêu chí an toàn quốc tế và xuất khẩu.

evidence.title: Giá xăng, dầu cùng giảm
evidence.summary: Từ 15h hôm nay, giá xăng dầu các loại cùng giảm 50-1.380 đồng một lít, theo đà diễn biến thị trường năng lượng thế giới.

evidence.title: Vì sao ông Trump áp thêm thuế nhập khẩu, bất chấp lạm phát?
evidence.summary: Thuế nhập khẩu là công cụ hữu hiệu giúp Tổng thống Mỹ thể hiện quyền lực kinh tế khi đảng Cộng hòa không còn kiểm soát Quốc hội.
